description: A Rust service's local checks, CI host and toolchain floor, with a CI move and an MSRV bump.

memories.text: Run `make ci` before pushing: it runs cargo fmt --check, clippy with -D warnings and the whole test suite.
Before a push, `make ci` has to pass; it covers formatting, clippy (warnings are errors) and every test.
make ci is the pre-push gate for widget-service (fmt + clippy -D warnings + tests); CI fails on anything it would catch.
Integration tests need a running Docker daemon; set WIDGET_SKIP_DOCKER=1 to skip them on a machine without one.
CI runs tests under nextest with --retries 1; a test that passes only on its retry is reported as FLAKY and must get an issue, not an #[ignore].
CI runs on Travis; the pipeline is defined in .travis.yml at the repository root.
CI runs on GitHub Actions; the workflow is .github/workflows/ci.yml and its jobs mirror the make ci stages.
The minimum supported Rust version is 1.70; do not use language features newer than that.
The minimum supported Rust version is 1.85, declared as rust-version in Cargo.toml; CI checks it in the msrv job.
store::tests::lease_expiry failed once on 2026-09-14 because the laptop suspended in the middle of the test run.
The CI build of commit 3f9c2a1 took 7m12s on the hosted runner.
Pushed branch fix/lease-timeout with the make ci run green and opened PR 412.
The nightly job is currently red because the upstream crates mirror is down.
API documentation is generated with `make docs` into target/doc; it is not committed.
